There are indeed several video games based on the Fairy Tail series. For the PlayStation Portable, there are three games: Fairy Tail: Portable Guild, Fairy Tail: Portable Guild 2, and Fairy Tail: Zeref Awakens. For the Nintendo DS, there are two fighting games: Fairy Tail: Fight! Wizard Battle and Fairy Tail: Attack! Kardia Cathedral. The characters Natsu and Lucy also appeared in the crossover video game Sunday VS Magazine: Shūketsu! Chōjō Daikessen. Lastly, a browser game titled Fairy Tail: Hero's Journey was announced in 2016.
[The End of Reference Answer]
